    Ext¹ between normalized modules (Lemma 6.3, n = 1) #

    "At a nonprojective label i, Lemma 2.9 and Proposition 2.6 give an exact sequence of representable functors […] We obtain a short exact sequence with terms M_{τi}, the middle mesh summands, and M_i, and both maps have degree one. […] It is right almost split […] Shifting its terms to make its maps degree zero gives 0 → M_{τi}⟨2⟩ → ⊕_{Y→i} M_Y⟨1⟩ → M_i → 0. Suppose that 0 → M_j⟨-t⟩ → X → M_i → 0 is a nonsplit graded extension with t > -2. It remains nonsplit after forgetting the grading […] Thus v factors through the right almost split map. Taking the degree-zero part makes this factorization graded. The induced map on kernels from M_j⟨-t⟩ to M_{τi}⟨2⟩ has underlying degree -t-2, so it is zero […] The factorization therefore descends to a section of the right almost split map, a contradiction."

    Here: the evaluated mesh maps πE, ιτ (exact_E, ιτ_injective), the right almost split property (exists_factor, not_retraction), and the vanishing (extOne_vanish).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
